title: Fail-closed Staging OA/MC four-principal preflight census

phases.objective: Report absent real Staging OA/MC multi-principal prerequisites without fabricating live acceptance, modifying identities or accessing Production.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Read-only SQL aggregate census for four-principal OA/MC live acceptance
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Emit an explicitly blocked, secret-free 18-case matrix until independently approved QA fixtures and live case evidence exist.
steps: Verify exact Staging runtime identity before any pool call.
Count active users, Tenants, active memberships, same-user dual-Tenant memberships, inactive subjects and revoked grants.
Check that Owner/Member Tenant A and independently owned Tenant B are possible from aggregated active role groups.
Report all OA-01..OA-08 and MC-01..MC-10 as not live certified; do not treat existing one-principal E2E as a replacement.
Block Production promotion and withhold identities or secrets.
assertions: No application or database mutation is performed.
No user IDs, emails, Tenant IDs, tokens or secrets appear in the report.
Missing fixture provenance, Admin principal and 18 case evidence are always explicit blockers.
Production and malformed environments fail closed.
